user.title: Guestbook
user.description: Select the entities Guestbook should watch. Every field is optional. You can change the selection later.

data_description.doorbells: Doorbell event entities or binary sensors. A ring starts the ring window.
data_description.doors: Door contacts. An opening after a ring turns it into a visit.
data_description.presence: Presence or motion sensors inside the home. Presence after a ring also turns it into a visit.
data_description.locks: Locks whose state changes appear in the visit log.
data_description.residents: Person entities of the people who live here. Residents never become visits.
data_description.resident_signals: Entities that prove a resident is arriving, for example a fingerprint reader or a resident phone.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Guestbook is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.

user.title: Add guest
user.description: Add a guest by name and link the phones that identify them. When a linked phone joins your network, Guestbook records a visit.

data_description.name: The name shown in the visit title.
data_description.trackers: Device trackers of the guest's phones, for example from your router.

reconfigure.title: Edit guest
reconfigure.description: Change the name or the linked phones of this guest.

data_description.name: The name shown in the visit title.
data_description.trackers: Device trackers of the guest's phones, for example from your router.

not_loaded.message: Guestbook is not set up or not loaded.

unknown_entry.message: There is no entry with the id {entry_id}. Use the id from the calendar event or from the sensor attributes.

entry_pending.message: The entry {entry_id} is a ring that is still waiting for a door opening or presence. Correct it after the ring window has ended.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.

resident_unlock.name: Resident unlock
resident_unlock.description: Reports that a resident is arriving or opening the door, so a ring close to it is not a visit.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional text that says where the signal came from, for example the name of a lock.

correct_entry.name: Correct entry
correct_entry.description: Tells Guestbook what an entry really was. The original decision is kept next to your correction.

entry_id.name: Entry id
entry_id.description: The id of the visit or ring, shown in the sensor attributes and the bus events.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: What the entry really was. A resident is shown in no calendar, a delivery in the rings calendar and a visit in the visits calendar. Unknown keeps the entry where the rules put it.

guest_name.name: Guest name
guest_name.description: Name of the guest, for a visit.

start.name: Start
start.description: Replaces the start time shown in the calendar.

end.name: End
end.description: Replaces the end time shown in the calendar.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text that is kept with the correction.

add_visit.name: Add visit
add_visit.description: Logs a visit the sensors missed.

guests.name: Guests
guests.description: Names of the guests. A name that matches a guest profile uses that profile.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text that is kept with the visit.

add_note.name: Add note
add_note.description: Adds a free-text note to an entry.

entry_id.name: Entry id
entry_id.description: The id of the visit or ring.
